(খ) এই সময়ে কত দূরত্ব গেল?","en":"A bus is moving at ${{u}}\\,\\text{m/s}$. The driver accelerates uniformly at ${{a}}\\,\\text{m/s}^2$ for ${{t}}\\,\\text{s}$. (a) What is the final velocity?
